Ramya, my student, wasn't getting any calls!
Why?
Because of 3 months notice period!!

Frustrated, she took the chance and resigned from her organization!
She updated in Naukri that she can join in about 45 days to 2 months.
She then started getting calls!!
She cracked a couple and got an offer.
𝐏𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐡𝐢 𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐤𝐢 𝐡𝐚𝐢...
Now, comes the villain
- her manager and manager's uplines and the HR
- nobody was ready to relieve from the organization earlier than 3 months.
Stressed, she was!!
The new product based company wasn't ready
to extend the joining date either!!
What do you do then?
I said.
"Stay calm.. The new company has invested time and
effort in hiring you. You have cracked the interview. They like you!
They will extend the joining date" and also
told some additional strategies on navigating the discussion with the HRs and managers of the new company!
Finally, her joining date was revised!!
What would you do in such a situation?

ai_analysis.summary: The post shares career advice about resigning from a job with a three-month notice period. It describes a student who resigned, advertised a 45-day to two-month joining availability on Naukri, received interview calls and an offer, and successfully negotiated a revised joining date after her current employer and the new employer initially could not extend it. It briefly contrasts notice periods in the United States and India but provides no technical data engineering knowledge; mentions of AWS, SQL, and PySpark are promotional or appear only in a document title.
